name: Tagawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Tagawa city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Tagawa, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1944.

features.role: Tagawa city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a four-pointed star
